channel.title: Cork Safety Alerts - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Cork Safety Alerts (corksafetyalerts.com)

item.title: Stolen Login Behind French Bank Database Breach
item.description: French bank breach exposes 1.2 million records via a stolen login. ESET Ireland warns the same tactics are used to target Irish consumers and businesses daily.

item.title: Sod Turned on New Macroom Garda Station to Serve as Cork County Divisional HQ
item.description: Construction begins on a new Garda station in Macroom that will serve as the Divisional HQ for Cork County, with completion expected in 2028.

item.title: Debris on M8 Northbound
item.description: Reports of debris, northbound, on the M8 Dublin Motorway between Junction 18 Glanmire and Junction 17 Watergrasshill (2 kilometres south of the Watergrasshill area). Take care on approach.Source: TII Traffic Alerts, 20 February at 14:20.

item.title: Collision at Greenfields Ballincllog
item.description: Reports of a collision at Greenfields, Ballincollig near the roundabout. Take care on approach.

item.title: Collision on Albert Road
item.description: Reports of a collision on Albert Road, Cork City. Take care on approach.

item.title: Power Outage Northside Cork City
item.description: Reports of a large power outage affecting Blarney Street and a number of areas on the Northside of Cork City. This may lead to traffic lights being out in the affected areas. Take extra care on approach to any junctions.

item.title: Debris on N40 Eastbound
item.description: Reports of debris, eastbound, on the N40 South Ring Road between Junction 6 (N27) Kinsale Road and Junction 7 South Douglas (Cork). Take care on approach.Source: TII Traffic Alerts, 21 February at 09:12.

item.title: Breakdown on N40 Westbound
item.description: Reports of a breakdown, westbound, on the N40 South Ring Road at N40(W) Off-Slip,Junction 6,N40W. Take care on approach.Source: TII Traffic Alerts, 21 February at 11:14.

item.title: Breakdown on N22 Macroom Bypass
item.description: Reports of a car broken down, westbound, on the N22 Macroom Bypass, between Ballyvourney and Macroom. Take care on approach.

item.title: Collision on N71 Rosscarbery
item.description: Reports of a collision on the N71 Rosscarbery, near the Celtic Ross Hotel. Emergency services are on scene. Take care on approach.
